item.title: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova Our humanitarian mission in
item.description: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova : ❗️ Our humanitarian mission in #Alyoshki has concluded . The convoys are now heading to their respective destinations . Those who decided to leave for Ukraine have been given the opportunity to do so. We will provide accommodation and the necessary support to residents staying in Russia . We delivered all the essential supplies and arranged safe passage out of the city . However, people still have much to resolve – medical treatment, housing, documents and reunification with their loved ones. We will help them. We also remain in contact with those who stayed in Alyoshki to keep track of their further needs. *** ❗️ I propose making humanitarian missions coordinated by US First Lady Melania Trump a regular practice . Our experience in Alyoshki and our joint work with my counterpart Dmitry Lubinets have shown that such agreements make it possible to help people even in the most difficult conditions . It is important to continue this work wherever civilians are waiting for support. I thank President of Russia Vladimir Putin , our Defence Ministry , the relevant services and our military personnel for helping carry out the mission and ensuring people’s safety. 🙏 Special thanks go to Melania Trump for her assistance and coordination.

⚡️
Russian MFA statement on the adoption of the UNGA resolution Necessity of Ending the Economic, Commercial and Financial Embargo Imposed by the US against Cuba
(October 29, 2026)
On October28,
the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
adopted
the resolution Necessity of Ending the Economic, Commercial and Financial Embargo Imposed by the US against Cuba
, traditionally tabled by the Republic of Cuba.
The resolution received
130 votes IN FAVOUR
, with 17 against and 25 abstentions.
✅
Russia
, together with the overwhelming majority of the international community,
consistently supported the document and
delivered a statement
to that effect
.
We are aware that this time
many countries came under intense
pressure aimed at forcing them to withhold their support for the resolution. However, despite this pressure and blackmail, the vote once again demonstrated
the international community’s virtually unanimous and unequivocal condemnation
of
the unlawful and inhumane embargo
against Havana.
It is clear that the US is failing in its attempts to turn unilateral sanctions into an instrument for coercing governments it disapproves of.
Cuba provides a particularly clear illustration of the pernicious nature of this destructive practice, which the White House employs to pursue its short-term objectives, in defiance of the consolidated position of the overwhelming majority of the international community and in complete disregard of the universally recognised principles and norms of international law.
The unprecedented escalation
this year of economic and military pressure on Havana
, compounded by an aggressive energy embargo,
has pushed ordinary Cubans to the brink of survival
. We are witnessing unlawful pressure against Cuba that has gone far beyond all accepted standards of human morality and decency.
The ultimate aim of such flagrant interference in the internal affairs of a sovereign country is clear to all
: to destabilise its domestic political situation, bring about regime change and impose on the Cuban people a different path of development dictated from abroad.
The inclusion of the Caribbean republic on
the US list of State Sponsors of Terrorism
serves the same purpose.
This designation remains one of the main obstacles facing Havana in conducting foreign trade and carrying out financial transactions
.
☝️
At the same time, it seems that those who are doing everything in their power to overthrow the current regime fail to appreciate
the devastating consequences
this could have:
a mass exodus of Cubans to neighbouring countries
in the event of socioeconomic collapse, thereby triggering a major migration crisis in those countries.
We admire the resilience and courage of the Government and the people of Cuba
. Despite the enormous pressure exerted by Washington, the Republic continues to demonstrate its principled and unwavering commitment to defending its sovereignty and independence, pursuing an independent foreign policy and keeping its socioeconomic situation under control.
❗️
Russia’s principled position on the resolution remains unchanged.
Together with the friendly people of Cuba and the overwhelming majority of members of the international community,
we will continue to demand the earliest possible, complete and unconditional lifting of the embargo against the Island of Freedom
.
Russia will always stand shoulder to shoulder with Cuba
in opposing unlawful unilateral restrictive measures and interference in the internal affairs of sovereign states.
#RussiaCuba

⚡️
Moscow Declaration of the Third Russia–Africa Summit
October 29, 2026
✍️
We, the Heads of State and Government of the Russian Federation and African States recognised by the United Nations (
#UN
), the Leadership of the African Union and leading African integration organisations (hereinafter referred to as Russia and Africa), gathered in Moscow (Russian Federation) on October 29, 2026, for
the Third Russia–Africa Summit
,
Building
on the historically established and time-tested bonds of friendship between Russia and African States, mutual respect and trust, and traditions of joint struggle against colonialism and for the independence of African States,
Welcoming
the growing standing in international affairs of African States, the African Union as the continent’s leading organisation, and regional integration organisations, reflecting Africa’s increasing global role and influence as one of the independent centres of the emerging
#MultipolarWorld
order,
Reaffirming
our commitment to the fundamental purposes and principles of
the UN Charter
in their entirety, taken together and in their interconnection and indivisibility,
Emphasising
the shared responsibility of Russia and African States for shaping a just, balanced and equitable
#MultipolarWorld
order based on the principles of the sovereign equality of States, non-interference in their internal affairs, respect for sovereignty, territorial integrity and the right of all peoples to self-determination, as enshrined, inter alia, in
UN General Assembly resolutions 1514 (XV) of December 14, 1960
, and
79/115 of December 4, 2024
,
Reaffirming
the need to jointly counter
contemporary colonial practices
in order to strengthen sovereignty, ensure free development and mutually beneficial cooperation, diversify external ties, and preserve national identity, traditional spiritual and moral values, and cultural and civilisational equality and diversity,
Opposing
all manifestations of racism, racial discrimination and discrimination on grounds of religion or origin, including xenophobia and related intolerance, aggressive nationalism, neo-Nazism and neo-fascism,
Expressing concern
over the current international security situation, characterised by growing potential for conflict at the global and regional levels, widespread instability, and increasing challenges and strategic risks resulting from heightened tensions between States, including those possessing nuclear weapons,
Calling
on the international community to consolidate political and diplomatic efforts aimed at reducing tensions overall, peacefully resolving ongoing conflicts and preventing new crises, and ensuring lasting and comprehensive global and regional stability on the basis of equal and indivisible security, mutual respect for each other’s fundamental interests, and the elimination of the root causes of conflicts and tensions,
🤝
Acting in accordance with the national legislation of Russia and African States, have agreed to develop cooperation in the following areas:
•
In the political and legal spheres
•
In ensuring security
•
In trade and economic affairs
•
In science, education, healthcare, culture, sport, youth policy and the media
•
In environmental protection and climate
***
The Heads of State and Government of African States recognised by the UN, the Leadership of the African Union and leading African integration organisations, as well as their representatives participating in
the Third Russia–Africa Summit
,
express their gratitude
to the Russian Federation and its people for organising and hosting this event in Moscow and
reaffirm their commitment to further joint efforts to deepen mutually beneficial, equitable and multifaceted cooperation
.
Read in full
#RussiaAfrica

✉️
Foreign Minister
Sergey Lavrov
’s video address to the organisers and participants in the
BRICS Interregional Business Forum
(Moscow, October 30, 2026)
✍️
I am pleased to greet the organisers and participants of the BRICS Interregional Business Forum,
an important element of the architecture of cooperation
within the group.
Despite the turbulent geopolitical situation, countries of the Global Majority are demonstrating
a genuine interest in expanding multifaceted cooperation
with one another and, in particular, with the Russian Federation. It is symbolic that you have gathered in St Petersburg, our country’s northern and cultural capital and a dynamically developing business centre of global significance.
Today,
#BRICS
is one of the driving forces behind global economic growth. The association accounts for
40 percent of global GDP
in terms of purchasing power parity and 23 percent of world trade. Trade between BRICS states has already reached
$1.2 trillion.
We believe it is important not to rest on our laurels but to continue our joint efforts
to fully unlock the considerable potential
for mutually beneficial cooperation.
This is the aim of Russia’s initiatives, including the development of international payment mechanisms resilient to external shocks and the establishment of
a New Investment Platform
to attract capital to key sectors of the economies of BRICS countries and the nations of the Global South and East in general.
Your meeting will also make
a significant contribution to our common efforts
to expand practical cooperation. Participants will have an opportunity to exchange experience on a wide range of issues essential to the prosperity of our regions and cities, as well as to review progress in implementing joint business projects.
I am confident that the forum will take place in
a traditionally constructive atmosphere,
helping to establish new business contacts, strengthen existing ties and promote friendship, mutual understanding and partnership between our countries and peoples.
An extensive cultural programme will also give participants
an opportunity to learn more about the rich historical and cultural heritage of St Petersburg,
which can be rightfully called a unique open-air museum.
I wish you fruitful discussions.

🎙
Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Ghana John Dramani Mahama on the sidelines of
the Third Russia–Africa Summit
(Moscow, October 30, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
Relations between our countries rest on foundations laid during
Ghana’s emergence as a sovereign, independent State
and its struggle against
the legacy of colonialism
.
We were among the first to establish diplomatic relations with Accra – our ties date back to 1958
. We helped build industrial facilities and social infrastructure and trained national professionals. Today, in a rapidly changing world, we strive to preserve and build on this shared legacy.
We note with satisfaction the increase in contacts at various levels
. A mechanism for political consultations is in place, and interparliamentary and interparty dialogue is developing.
📈
Ghana ranks twelfth among African countries in terms of trade with Russia.
However, it is one of our largest trading partners in sub-Saharan Africa. Bilateral trade
grew by 6%
in January-August, so the overall trend is positive.
We will, of course, continue to support Ghana in education and help train national professionals
. Currently,
649 young people
from Ghana are studying in Russia. I understand that, during your visit, you have been awarded an honorary doctorate by a Russian university.
We are interested in strengthening coordination with Ghana in international forums.
We appreciate your longstanding support for Russian resolutions at the UN.
🤝
We also welcome
Accra’s independent stance under your leadership
,
Mr President,
in
combating neocolonialism
and in pursuing its foreign policy more broadly.
🇷🇺
🇬🇭
#RussiaGhana

item.title: 🇷🇺 On 29 October 2026, Moscow hosted the main events of the Third Russia–Africa Summit!
item.description: 🇷🇺 🌍 On 29 October 2026, Moscow hosted the main events of the Third Russia–Africa Summit! #Day2 • The plenary session of the Third #RussiaAfrica Summit took place at the Grand Kremlin Palace, co-chaired by Russian President Vladimir Putin and African Union Chair, President of Burundi Évariste Ndayishimiye . 🤝 The motto: “For Peace, Security and Development.” • At the close of the 3rd Russia – Africa Summit, Vladimir Putin and the Chairperson of the African Union, President of the Republic of Burundi Évariste Ndayishimiye, held a joint press conference. • The Summit adopted the Declaration of the Third Russia–Africa Summit, the Declaration on Cooperation in the Field of Civilian Applications of Artificial Intelligence, and the Russia–Africa Partnership Forum Action Plan for 2027–2029. On the sidelines of the Summit, Vladimir Putin also held a series of bilateral meetings: 🇳🇦 with Namibian President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah; 🇨🇬 with President of the Republic of the Congo Denis Sassou Nguesso; 🇧🇮 with Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye; 🇰🇪 with Kenyan President William Samoei Ruto. *** 💬 Vladimir Putin: Holding such large-scale events has become a good tradition and clearly demonstrates the firm determination of both Russia and African states to further strengthen and develop multifaceted ties in the spirit of genuine partnership and mutual respect for the sake of universal growth and prosperity.
